sloka: दशग्रीवं जयेत्याहुरसुराः समवस्थिताः ।देवा राममथोचुस्ते त्वं जयेति पुनःपुनः ।। ६.१०४.८ ।।
transliteration: daśagrīvaṁ jayetyāhurasurāḥ samavasthitāḥ ।devā rāmamathocuste tvaṁ jayeti punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.104.8 ।।

translations.english: Firmly established the Asuras uttered 'Victory to the Ten headed Ravana', and Devas for their part pronounced 'Rama be victorious' again and again.
